rules.name: A Simpler Time (rule 1)
rules.description: One of the main advancements during the second half of the 18th century was the introduction of carronades. Therefore, remove this from all ship profiles. All carronades should be treated as light guns instead (already included in statlines).

rules.name: A Simpler Time (rule 2)
rules.description: Cannons were less accurate. All shooting has an additional -1 to hit.

rules.name: A Simpler Time (rule 3)
rules.description: Muskets were also less accurate, or sailors used bows and arrows instead.  If using the Advanced Rule Musket Fire, add 2 instead of 3 to the damage if successful.

rules.name: A Simpler Time (rule 4)
rules.description: Finally, ships were not as sturdy as those of the latter period. Reduce the Ship Points of all ships (apart from the Galleon, which has been added to the list for the purpose of playing games in an earlier setting) by 10% rounding up. The points value of each ship remains the same (already included in statlines).

rules.name: More "Carronades"
rules.description: Add +1C to each broadside (already included in statline as +1L to each broadside).
